## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing**
TrendForce June 1 retrospective: Q1-2026 conventional DRAM contracts rose **~81% QoQ** (baseline was ~90-95% — slight undershoot). Q2-2026 forecast: conventional DRAM **+58-63% QoQ** (decelerating vs Q1), mobile LPDDR5X +78-83% QoQ. Crucially, HBM contract ASPs reportedly declining in parallel as all three suppliers ramp — the baseline correction-risk signal is live.

**Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp / Correction Risk**
SK Hynix pushed HBM4 capacity ramp from Q2 → **Q3 2026** (HBM3E demand absorbed lines longer than planned). HBM4 mass production launched Feb 2026. Samsung targeting 50% HBM capacity surge by end-2026 (~250K wafers/month). All three suppliers converging on schedule — correction-risk thesis advancing uninterrupted.

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler AI Capex**
No fresh 72h print. Guidance aggregates stand at **$700-725B for 2026** (+77% YoY), above the baseline's $600-700B ceiling. No guide-down signals visible.

**Signal 4 — AMD MI400/Helios + Custom ASICs**
No new AMD update. MI400/Helios on track for 2H-2026 (Feb 23 confirmation still standing). Meta's MTIA 300-500 series roadmap unveiled: MTIA 400 delivers 6 PFLOPS FP8 + 288GB HBM at 9.2 Tbps. AWS Trainium4 targets late-2026/early-2027. Custom ASIC CAGR 44.6%; inference = two-thirds of all AI compute.

**Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics**
COHR demonstrated CPO technologies at OFC 2026: 6.4T socketed CPO on silicon photonics with InP lasers; 400G InP modulator array. InP supply gap ~70% remains. Large-scale CPO deployment still 2028-2030. COHR +5.29% June 15.

**Signal 6 — Solar**
Section 232 polysilicon tariff ruling expected **by end of June 2026** — pending. FSLR's CdTe thin-film tech insulates it from silicon-based tariff pain → direct beneficiary thesis intact. UBS raised FSLR target $290 → $330 on June 11 (+9% that day). Solar stocks +40% YTD. China FOB module ~$0.085-0.095/W; US delivered ~$0.27-0.32/W post-tariff stack.

**Signal 7 — Watchlist Catalysts (June 15-16)**
Broad macro lift June 15 on US-Iran peace deal reducing oil risk.

| **MU** | +8% | Analyst target raises ahead of June 24 Q3 earnings; AI memory demand; macro lift |

No notable news on: STX, WDC, SanDisk (SNDK), RMBS, MRAM, LITE, CIEN, ENPH, NXT, ARRY, NOW, ZS, CRM, SNOW, TSLA, GDDY, NOK, AMPX, ALMU.

## Context (vs Baseline)

- DRAM Q1 actual (+81% QoQ) slightly missed baseline's ~90-95% — still historic; Q2 deceleration anticipated, not a surprise.
- HBM correction-risk: SK Hynix HBM4 slip to Q3 + Samsung capacity surge = convergence on track for late-2026 correction window.
- Hyperscaler capex $725B is above the baseline $600-700B range → upside.
- MRVL's NVDA NVLink Fusion partnership is exactly the "NVIDIA names a partner" signal this routine tracks.

| Optical InP supply | Constrained | Bull COHR, LITE |
| Solar Section 232 | Ruling imminent | Bull FSLR |
| MRVL-NVDA partnership | Confirmed & valued | Strong bull |

## Most Important Development

**MRVL S&P 500 inclusion (June 22) + NVIDIA NVLink Fusion partnership ($2B investment, Jensen "next trillion-dollar" at Computex)** → multiple analyst upgrades ($300-345 targets) → +5.16% June 15. Classic must-catch catalyst. Second: **MU +8%** into June 24 earnings is the market's real-time vote on whether Q2 DRAM prints above the +58-63% QoQ TrendForce consensus — watch that report closely.
